mechanics.claim: Graves fires a shell that deals damage to enemies hit along its path, then explodes on hitting a champion or reaching max range for reduced cone damage to additional enemies.
mechanics.quote: fires an explosive shell in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and causes him to {{tip|dash|recoil}} 400 units in the opposite direction.

mechanics.claim: The shell applies single-target spell damage to the champion it hits, and separate area damage to targets in the explosion cone.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the target hit by the shell (including to non-champions struck before exploding{{bug}}) and {{tip|area damage}} to targets within the explosion cone.

mechanics.claim: A target hit directly by the shell can take both the initial shell damage and the cone explosion damage if within range of the cone.
mechanics.quote: Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes in a cone to deal reduced damage to additional enemies.
